title: Pricing Desk Note: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Excess Adder Where the Premise Also Takes Business Electricity
content:
In the correction of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply swing excess charge line, the adder priced on each excess therm over the month's delivered index price follows the business's electricity supply at the same premise:

- when the Beacon Ridge Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on that premise is active on a fixed term, that is with a term of more than 0 months, the adder is $0.0200 per therm;
- when it is active on a month-to-month plan, that is with a term of 0 months, the adder is $0.0300 per therm;
- in every other case no electricity-linked adder applies, and the plan's own swing excess adder stands.

The status and the term in months are read from the Small Business Electricity Supply agreement record for the same premise as the gas site.

## Adder by electricity holding

| Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on the same premise | Term on that agreement | Adder per excess therm |
|---|---|---|
| Active | More than 0 months | $0.0200 |
| Active | 0 months (month-to-month) | $0.0300 |
| Any status other than active, or no such agreement on the premise | Any | No electricity-linked adder |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A bakery's gas site also holds an active Small Business Electricity Supply agreement on a 24-month term. Each excess therm on its corrected swing excess line is priced at the cycle's delivered index price plus $0.0200.
- A second site of the same bakery holds an active month-to-month electricity agreement on Small Business Electricity Supply. The adder there is $0.0300.
- A third site's electricity agreement is drop pending. It is not active, so no electricity-linked adder applies to that gas site.
- Only the premise of the gas site matters: an active electricity agreement at a different premise of the business does not change the adder.
